title: The Broken Pot
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Sanyu breaks Jjajja's special pot and learns about the weight of lies and the freedom of truth.
keywords: honesty, truth, confession, guilt, Uganda, girls, virtue
dedication: For every girl learning that the truth, though hard, sets us free.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Sanyu breaks something precious and hides it. But the secret weighs on her heart until she finds the courage to tell the truth.
